name: Minimum sum-product size for 32 positive integers
definition: Choose a set A of exactly 32 positive integers, with no upper bound on its elements, to minimize max(|A+A|, |AA|), where A+A={a+b:a,b in A} and AA={ab:a,b in A}.
solution_format: An object with elements, a list of 32 distinct positive integers.
constraints: Every element is a positive integer, with no fixed upper bound.
A+A contains a+b for all ordered choices a,b in A; AA contains ab for all ordered choices a,b in A.
verification: The checker validates all 32 distinct positive integers and recomputes both finite sets of pairwise sums and products exactly using arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic.
